summary: At zero-based segment 0, step 53, the hallucination timer clears while the hero is still mimicking a small mimic corpse. C potion.c:make_hallucinated() calls eat.c:eatmupdate(); that function replaces the orange-object mimic appearance and pending completion message with the nonhallucinatory gold-piece appearance/message, then redraws the hero. JS potion.js:make_hallucinated() instead reaches note_unported('eat.c eatmupdate') and leaves the orange mimic visible. A current-base fresh replay reproduces the first screen difference at step 53; the later first RNG difference is m_move at call 2259, after the caller skipped the helper.

The full function also includes the source's GOLD_PIECE-to-ORANGE branch when hallucination starts.
callers: The only direct C caller is potion.c:make_hallucinated() at line 418, on its changed && !Hallucination branch. That source function is already represented by js/potion.js:make_hallucinated(); its current JavaScript path calls note_unported('eat.c eatmupdate') at lines 983-987 instead of wiring this helper. The return is void and discarded in C.
dependencies: monst.h:is_obj_mappear() and M_AP_TYPE are macros, not separate C functions to port; they test m_ap_type and mappearance.
display.c:newsym() is an existing screen-update helper. eatmupdate() consumes no return-valued unported dependency and makes no random draw.

ge.eatmbuf and gn.nomovemsg are already represented as state.eatmbuf and state.nomovemsg by js/eat.js corpse-mimic handling; state.youmonst.mappearance is the hero's C mappearance. The two message references must be replaced together as in C's buffer copy.
source.javascriptGap: js/potion.js:make_hallucinated() currently records note_unported('eat.c eatmupdate') when a live hallucination transition ends. There is no canonical js/eat.js:eatmupdate() implementation yet.
